passages.text: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs.
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the mother of Ahaziah.
She saw that her son Ahaziah was dead.
Athaliah acted immediately.
She destroyed all the royal heirs.
passages.original: וַֽעֲתַלְיָה֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ וְרָאֲתָה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑הּ וַתָּ֙קָם֙ וַתְּאַבֵּ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע הַמַּמְלָכָֽה׃

passages.text: But Jehosheba daughter of King Joram, the sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah, and he was not killed.
passages.sermon:
Jehosheba was the daughter of King Joram.
Jehosheba was the sister of Ahaziah.
Joash was the son of Ahaziah.
Jehosheba took Joash.
She took him from among the king’s sons.
The king’s sons were being murdered.
Jehosheba stole Joash away.
She took Joash and his nurse.
She put them in a bedroom.
She hid them from Athaliah.
Joash was not killed.
passages.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֶׁ֣בַע בַּת־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ י֠וֹרָם אֲח֨וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֜הוּ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֗ה וַתִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַמָּמוֹתְתִים אֹת֥וֹ וְאֶת־ מֵינִקְתּ֖וֹ בַּחֲדַ֣ר הַמִּטּ֑וֹת וַיַּסְתִּ֧רוּ אֹת֛וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א הוּמָֽת׃

passages.text: And Joash remained hidden with his nurse in the house of the LORD for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
passages.sermon:
Joash was a young boy.
His nurse cared for him.
They hid together in the house of the LORD.
They stayed hidden for six years.
During those six years, Athaliah ruled over the land.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י אִתָּהּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מִתְחַבֵּ֖א שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַעֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

passages.text: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD. There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son and commanded them, “This is what you are to do: A third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall guard the royal palace, a third shall be at the gate of Sur, and a third at the gate behind the guards. You are to take turns guarding the temple— the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was a priest in Israel.
In the seventh year, Jehoiada acted.
He sent for the commanders of hundreds.
He also sent for the Carites and the guards.
Jehoiada brought them into the house of the LORD.
He made a covenant with them there.
He put them under oath in the house of the LORD.
Jehoiada showed them the king’s son.
He gave them instructions.
He said, “This is what you must do.
A third of you will come on duty on the Sabbath.
This group will guard the royal palace.
A second third will be at the gate of Sur.
A third group will be at the gate behind the guards.
You must guard the temple in turns.
The two divisions who go off duty on the Sabbath must guard the house of the LORD for the king.”
passages.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַ֨ח יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וַיִּקַּ֣ח׀ אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת לַכָּרִי֙ וְלָ֣רָצִ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם בְּרִ֜ית וַיַּשְׁבַּ֤ע אֹתָם֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥רְא אֹתָ֖ם אֶת־ בֶּן־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ וַיְצַוֵּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֤ית מִכֶּם֙ בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וְשֹׁ֣מְרֵ֔י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר ס֔וּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֥ית בַּשַּׁ֖עַר אַחַ֣ר הָרָצִ֑ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבַּ֖יִת מַסָּֽח׃ וּשְׁתֵּ֤י הַיָּדוֹת֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְשָֽׁמְר֛וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: You must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who approaches the ranks must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.”
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
He gave orders to the guards.
He told them to protect the young king Joash.
He said, "You must stand around the king."
Each man must hold his weapon in his hand.
If anyone comes near your ranks, you must kill him.
You must stay with the king at all times.
You must guard him when he goes out.
You must guard him when he comes in.
passages.original: וְהִקַּפְתֶּ֨ם עַל־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֔וֹ וְהַבָּ֥א אֶל־ הַשְּׂדֵר֖וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וִהְי֥וּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּצֵאת֥וֹ וּבְבֹאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So the commanders of hundreds did everything that Jehoiada the priest had ordered. Each of them took his men—those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest.
passages.sermon:
The commanders of hundreds obeyed Jehoiada the priest.
They did everything Jehoiada commanded.
Each commander gathered his men.
Some men were coming on duty for the Sabbath.
Other men were going off duty from the Sabbath.
All the commanders and their men went to Jehoiada the priest.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵן֒ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: Then the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the priest.
Jehoiada took the spears and shields.
These spears and shields belonged to King David.
Jehoiada kept these weapons in the house of the LORD.
Jehoiada gave the spears and shields to the commanders of hundreds.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the guards stood with weapons in hand surrounding the king by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
passages.sermon:
The guards stood around the king.
Each guard held his weapon in his hand.
They stood from the south side of the temple to the north side.
They stood by the altar and the temple.
They surrounded the king.
passages.original: וַיַּעַמְד֨וּ הָרָצִ֜ים אִ֣ישׁ׀ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֗וֹ מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֤יִת הַיְמָנִית֙ עַד־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְלַבָּ֑יִת עַל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Then Jehoiada brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, presented him with the Testimony, and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and declared, “Long live the king!”
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the priest.
Jehoiada brought out the king’s son.
Jehoiada put the crown on the king’s son.
Jehoiada gave the king’s son the Testimony.
Jehoiada and the people made the king’s son king.
They anointed the king’s son.
The people clapped their hands.
The people said, “Long live the king!”
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א אֶת־ בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ הַנֵּ֙זֶר֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣עֵד֔וּת וַיַּמְלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻ֑הוּ וַיַּכּוּ־ כָ֔ף וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס

passages.text: When Athaliah heard the noise from the guards and the people, she went out to the people in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the queen.
She heard the noise from the guards.
She also heard the noise from the people.
She went to the people.
She entered the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֔ה אֶת־ ק֥וֹל הָֽרָצִ֖ין הָעָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And she looked out and saw the king standing by the pillar, according to the custom. The officers and trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, “Treason! Treason!”
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the queen who ruled over Judah.
She looked out and saw the king’s son standing by the pillar.
The pillar was the place where kings stood during ceremonies.
The king stood there as was the custom.
The officers stood beside the king.
The trumpeters stood beside the king.
All the people of the land rejoiced.
The people blew trumpets.
Athaliah tore her clothes.
Athaliah cried out, “Treason! Treason!”
passages.original: וַתֵּ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּ֣ה הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־ הָעַמּ֜וּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט וְהַשָּׂרִ֤ים וְהַחֲצֹֽצְרוֹת֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־ עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שָׂמֵ֔חַ וְתֹקֵ֖עַ בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֑וֹת וַתִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָה֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדֶ֔יהָ וַתִּקְרָ֖א קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר׃ס

passages.text: And Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army, “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the priest.
He gave an order to the commanders of hundreds.
These commanders led the army.
Jehoiada spoke to them.
He said, “Take her out from the house of the LORD to the ranks outside.”
He said, “Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.”
Jehoiada had said, “Do not kill her in the house of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיְצַו֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּיאוֹת פְּקֻדֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־ מִבֵּ֣ית לַשְּׂדֵרֹ֔ת וְהַבָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ הָמֵ֣ת בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אַל־ תּוּמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So they seized Athaliah as she reached the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the queen who ruled over Judah.
The soldiers seized Athaliah.
They took hold of her.
They led her to the entrance where the horses enter the king’s palace.
They killed Athaliah there.
passages.original: וַיָּשִׂ֤מוּ לָהּ֙ יָדַ֔יִם וַתָּב֛וֹא דֶּֽרֶךְ־ מְב֥וֹא הַסּוּסִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתּוּמַ֖ת שָֽׁם׃ס

passages.text: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people that they would be the LORD’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
Jehoiada made a covenant.
He made this covenant between the LORD, the king, and the people.
The covenant said the people would belong to the LORD.
Jehoiada also made a covenant between the king and the people.
passages.original: וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִ֗ית בֵּ֤ין יְהוָה֙ וּבֵ֤ין הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הָעָ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת לְעָ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּבֵ֥ין הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבֵ֥ין הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: So all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. And Jehoiada the priest posted guards for the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
All the people of the land went to the temple of Baal.
They tore the temple down.
They smashed the altars of Baal.
They broke the idols of Baal into pieces.
They killed Mattan, the priest of Baal.
They killed him in front of the altars.
Jehoiada was the priest of the LORD.
Jehoiada posted guards at the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ כָל־ עַם֩ הָאָ֨רֶץ בֵּית־ הַבַּ֜עַל וַֽיִּתְּצֻ֗הוּ אֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתוֹ וְאֶת־ צְלָמָיו֙ שִׁבְּר֣וּ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְאֵ֗ת מַתָּן֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַבַּ֔עַל הָרְג֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הַֽמִּזְבְּח֑וֹת וַיָּ֧שֶׂם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן פְּקֻדּ֖וֹת עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace by way of the Gate of the Guards. Then Joash took his seat on the royal throne, and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been put to the sword at the royal palace.
passages.sermon:
Joash was the king of Judah.
Joash was a child at this time.
Jehoiada the priest led the people.
Jehoiada took the commanders of hundreds.
He took the Carites.
He took the guards.
He took all the people of the land.
They brought Joash the king down from the house of the LORD.
They entered the royal palace.
They went by way of the Gate of the Guards.
Joash sat on the royal throne.
All the people of the land rejoiced.
The city became quiet.
They had put Athaliah to death by the sword at the royal palace.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ֠מֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־ הַכָּרִ֨י וְאֶת־ הָרָצִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֗רֶץ וַיֹּרִ֤ידוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּב֛וֹאוּ דֶּֽרֶך־ שַׁ֥עַר הָרָצִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א הַמְּלָכִֽים׃ וַיִּשְׂמַ֥ח כָּל־ עַם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהָעִ֣יר שָׁקָ֑טָה וְאֶת־ עֲתַלְיָ֛הוּ הֵמִ֥יתוּ בַחֶ֖רֶב בֵּ֥ית מֶלֶךְ׃ס

passages.text: Joash was seven years old when he became king.
passages.sermon: Joash became king.\r\nJoash was seven years old at that time.
